GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.3 (14 Nov 45) ESS/IN
(SCAPIN - 281)
APO 500
14 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Release of Coal Stocks
1. Reference is made to your CLO Memorandum 448(2) regarding coal stocks now in the possession of munitions companies, and to CLO Memorandum 364(1) regarding coal stocks now in the possession of the Japanese Army and Navy.
2. These two matters are being referred to the Sixth and Eighth Army Headquarters, and you will contact them for further appropriate action.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
